# @aponiajs/opentelemetry

> Opt-in OpenTelemetry distributed tracing, W3C `traceparent` propagation, and HTTP server span lifecycle over `@opentelemetry/api`.

## What this package exports

- `OpenTelemetryModule.forRoot(options?)` and `OpenTelemetryModule.forRootAsync(options)`
- `OpenTelemetryService`: `getTracer()`, `currentSpan()`, `extractContext()`, `injectHeaders()`, `withSpan()`
- `MODULE_OPTIONS_TOKEN`, `OPENTELEMETRY_OPTIONS`
